Use case: ads-marketing / compositing. Create a premium finished PUMPKART promotional poster featuring EVERY one of the FIFTEEN supplied racers, each EXACTLY ONCE. Landscape social campaign poster, approximately 3:2 aspect, high-resolution detail. Reference image 1 is a labeled sheet showing Orangie, TJR, Rasmr, Kimchi and Ansem. Reference image 2 is a labeled sheet showing Elon, Brezscales, Jack Duval, Vitalik and Rowdy. Reference image 3 is a labeled sheet showing CookerFlips, FaZe Banks, Fomo, Pump and Axiom. Each sheet contains exactly FIVE separate racer/vehicle identities, fifteen total. Blank space in the reference sheets is not another character. Reference image 4 is the official PUMPKART wordmark. Do not copy the reference-sheet 3+2 layout: the FINAL poster must be FIVE columns and THREE rows, all fifteen subjects each exactly once. Preserve each face, clothing, mascot silhouette, vehicle type, props and colors. This must be a visually designed game promotional poster, not a website screenshot.
Art direction: glossy detailed racing-game key art, midnight Tokyo neon city / futuristic pit garage setting, almost-black plum base, vivid hot pink #FF006E and cyan lights, subtle wet asphalt and checkered finish-line details. Bold energetic editorial typography, restrained glow, sharp readable subjects. The 15 cast members occupy a clean balanced FIVE-COLUMN by THREE-ROW starting-grid showcase, with perspective and diagonal accents for energy but every distinct racer and their ENTIRE vehicle visible. Do not pile them into an unreadable crowd. Each cell has the racer prominently lit against the unified dark city-pit setting, with a simple legible name below; no small illegible body text. Generous clear header and footer.
Exact arrangement and subject locks:
ROW 1 left to right: ORANGIE (curly-haired glasses boy in black hoodie on turbo wheelchair with taco cups); TJR (gold chains, sunglasses, white shirt, red blown hypercar with cash); RASMR (black shirt, glass of red wine, motorized silver shopping cart); KIMCHI (Asian driver, tan car with giant blond Trump head mounted on nose); ANSEM (yellow-shirt Black driver riding black bull on monster-truck wheels).
ROW 2: ELON (Elon Musk driving angular chrome cyber buggy); BREZSCALES (curly-haired black-hoodie driver perched on red supercar hood, steering with chains); JACK DUVAL (olive-shirt driver in white-red-blue boat on wheels with twin outboards); VITALIK (Vitalik in blue rainbow shirt driving pink unicorn toy car); ROWDY (black shiny shirt, finger-gun gesture, black supercar and RETIRED front plate).
ROW 3: COOKERFLIPS (blonde anime girl, braided hair, glasses, pink beret, pink heart-and-wings kart); FAZE BANKS (bearded tattooed man in black cap and FAZE CLAN hoodie in red-yellow-blue brick-built kart with cash); FOMO (white Fomo symbol-shaped mascot head, purple eyes, orange-purple-black kart); PUMP (green-white pill mascot, lightning sunglasses, gold chain, lime green-black pump.fun kart); AXIOM (silver triangular mascot head, blue eyes, silver-blue-black kart).
Typography must read EXACTLY: recognizable wordmark 'PUMPKART' at the top using image4; huge headline 'MEET THE FULL GRID'; each of the 15 name labels spelled as above; concise bottom tagline '5 RACERS. 1 WINNER.' and website 'pumpkart.racing'. No extra captions, dates, investment claims, token contract address, fake logos, watermark or prices.
Count and identity are critical: exactly 15 racers, all 15 supplied distinct vehicles, no duplicate character, no absent character, no combining faces or cars. Preserve the motorcycle-like wheelchair, bull, boat, shopping cart and anime kart instead of turning everyone into generic racing cars. Aim for a collectible roster poster with genuine visual impact and clean small-screen readability.

Use case: ads-marketing / compositing. Create a stunning cinematic PUMPKART game promo poster called THE BIG THREE. Landscape 3:2 high-resolution social artwork, polished 3D blockbuster racing-game key art. Exact references: image1 AXIOM (silver triangular mascot head, black face band and glowing blue eyes, tongue-out expression, black blue hoodie, silver-blue-black AXIOM kart); image2 FOMO (white symbol-shaped head, purple glowing eyes, playful tongue-out grin, orange-black hoodie, orange-purple-black Fomo kart with flame exhaust); image3 PUMP (green-white pill head, lightning sunglasses, gold chain and pill pendant, black pump.fun hoodie, lime-green-black pump.fun kart); image4 official PUMPKART wordmark. Preserve each mascot and its distinctive vehicle and existing branding faithfully.
Scene: three rivals charging neck-and-neck across a black-and-white CHECKERED FINISH LINE on a neon Tokyo street at night. Low front three-quarter tracking camera makes the trio large, powerful and equally readable. AXIOM left in an electric-blue streak; FOMO center with orange-purple flames; PUMP right in vivid lime-green exhaust. The trio and all three karts dominate the lower two-thirds, faces clearly visible, readable wheels and bodywork, no overlapping faces or merged cars, all three vehicles substantially visible. Wet asphalt reflects those three colors, subtle tire smoke, sparks, motion streaks, blurred futuristic city towers and hot-pink racing light gantry. Background atmosphere adds movement without overwhelming the characters. Three luminous color lanes converge toward the finish for a thrilling photo-finish, no identifiable winner. Exactly three characters, no extras.
Graphic layout: official PUMPKART wordmark at top left; enormous beautifully set upper headline 'THE BIG THREE' in bold italic futuristic white lettering with a restrained magenta accent. Smaller line directly below reads EXACTLY 'AXIOM × FOMO × PUMP'. Bottom tagline EXACTLY 'THREE ICONS. ONE FINISH LINE.' and clean website 'pumpkart.racing'. All copy crisp, legible, properly spelled, safely inset at least 5% from edges. No extra text, dates, investment promises, prices, fake sponsors, watermark, UI or app screenshot. Make this feel like the announcement of three iconic new playable racers, wild and premium, not a static garage card.
